import os, sys, time, json
# 8MB of many tiny objects -> parsed then E_SCHEMA (unrecognized keys)
inner = '{"a":1,"b":2,"c":3,"d":4},'
arr = '[' + inner * (8388608 // len(inner)) + ']'
doc = '{"x":' + arr + '}'
data = doc.encode()
print('bytes', len(data))
r_in, w_in = os.pipe(); r_out, w_out = os.pipe()
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.dup2(r_in, 0); os.dup2(w_out, 1); os.close(r_out); os.close(w_in)
    os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'])

t0 = time.time()
import threading
def feed():
    try: os.write(w_in, data)
    finally: os.close(w_in)
th = threading.Thread(target=feed); th.start()
out = b''
while True:
    c = os.read(r_out, 1 << 20)
    if not c: break
    out += c
th.join(); os.close(r_out)
_, status, usage = os.wait4(pid, 0)
print('wall=%.2f peak_rss=%.1f MiB out=%r' % (time.time()-t0, usage.ru_maxrss/1024.0, out[:40]))
